description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a phone, filtering MCP tools and selecting one keep focus in the input. The page lists MCP servers web and library, each with a tool "search", and locked, whose tools fail to load. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills. 2. Fill the input with "/skills " (with the trailing space); the input should have focus. 3. The input should have focus. 6. Click the option. 7. The chip should contain "search". 8. The input's value should be exactly "", and the input should have focus.
